annotations.title: Financial remedy timetable (FPR 2010 Part 9: Forms E, H and H1)

description: Works out the financial remedy timetable in the family court in England and Wales (FPR 2010 Part 9; standard, fast-track and the Express pilot under PD 36ZH): the first appointment 12 to 16 weeks after issue, Form E 5 weeks before it, the documents 14 days before, the FDR and its offers, open proposals (FPR 9.27A, 9.28), Form H at every hearing and Form H1 before the final hearing (9.27), FM5, ES1 and ES2 and the bundle (PD 27A; Financial Remedies Guide 2026). Dates only: it never advises on the merits, the division or costs.

fdr.description: Optional: the FDR appointment, once fixed (YYYY-MM-DD).

filed.description: The day the application (Form A or A1) was filed (YYYY-MM-DD).

finalHearing.description: Optional: the first day of the final hearing, once fixed (YYYY-MM-DD).

firstAppointment.description: Optional: the first appointment or first hearing, from the court's notice (YYYY-MM-DD).

issued.description: "fast-track" and "express": the day it was issued, if not the day it was filed (YYYY-MM-DD).

noFdr.description: No FDR appointment will take place (FPR 9.27A(2)).

noFm5.description: No FM5: the MIAM requirement does not apply, or the domestic abuse exemption was claimed (PD 3A paras 10B and 13).

procedure.description: The financial remedy procedure: "standard" (Standard procedure (FPR Part 9 Chapter 4): first appointment, FDR, final hearing), "fast-track" (Fast-track procedure (Chapter 5): periodical payments only, or varying them), "express" (Express pilot (PD 36ZH): divorce finances under £250,000 at a pilot court, filed 7 April 2025 to 2 April 2027).

served.description: "fast-track": the day the application was served on the respondent (YYYY-MM-DD).
